stem.text: Why is the first ionisation energy of oxygen less than that of nitrogen?

A.text: The nitrogen atom has its outer electron in a different subshell.

B.text: The nuclear charge on the oxygen atom is greater than that on the nitrogen atom.

C.text: The oxygen atom has a pair of electrons in one p orbital that repel one another.

D.text: There is more shielding in an oxygen atom.
